meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

copy.tagline: 为 NanoClaw 添加新通道或修改行为
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在定制 NanoClaw 的行为或集成新通道。
copy.tagline_en: Add new channels or modify NanoClaw behavior
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are customizing NanoClaw's behavior or integrating new channels.

howto.what: Claude会主动提问来了解你想要如何自定义NanoClaw，然后根据你的需求添加新的通信通道（如Telegram、Slack）、修改触发规则、集成外部服务，或调整助理行为。
howto.when: 当你提到要添加通道（Telegram、Slack等）、修改触发规则、添加集成或进行任何其他自定义时触发。

say.text: 帮我把Telegram添加为输入通道
say.note: Claude会引导完成安装和配置

say.text: 修改某个agent组的触发规则
say.note: 可指定新的关键词或会话模式

howto.what_en: Claude asks clarifying questions to understand your customization needs, then adds channels (Telegram, Slack, etc.), modifies triggers, integrates services, or adjusts assistant behavior accordingly.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention adding channels, changing triggers, adding integrations, or making other customizations to NanoClaw.

say_en.text: Add Telegram as an input channel
say_en.note: Claude will guide through installation and setup

say_en.text: Change trigger rules for an agent group
say_en.note: Specify new keywords or session modes
Claude asks about target agent group and permissions
